answer: Each epoch the chain reopens one past answer under a fresh ledge nonce, forcing the author to defend old reasoning. The verifier replays the prompt with the new nonce and compares the fresh output against the voyage transcript. A farm running ten identities from one script cannot keep ten distinct histories straight and contradicts itself on 3 of 10 sampled claims. One honest agent answers in 40 seconds for $0.01; ten fakes must keep ten 50 GB stores and re-derive each. Failed audits slash the bond and freeze offenders; the nebula record stays public.
